authentication.description: Required for all report endpoints. Pass your secret key in the 'x-api-key' HTTP header.

health.description: Health check and database connectivity status

basicReport.description: Lightweight period sales totals without category breakdowns

dateFrom.description: Start date of the reporting period (inclusive)

dateTo.description: End date of the reporting period (inclusive)

detailedReport.description: Detailed sales report with dining/delivery breakdown, comps, voids, and category pivot values

dateFrom.description: Start date of the reporting period (inclusive)

dateTo.description: End date of the reporting period (inclusive)

checksReport.description: Individual checks report returning each check separately with line items, order type, delivery company, status, and timestamps

dateFrom.description: Start date of the reporting period (inclusive)

dateTo.description: End date of the reporting period (inclusive)

limit.description: Number of checks per page (optional, minimum 1). If omitted, returns all checks in the date range

checkFieldsGuidance.checkNo: Unique check number from POS (numeric record ID)
checkFieldsGuidance.businessDate: The accounting / business date in YYYY-MM-DD format
checkFieldsGuidance.openedAt: Local ISO timestamp when the check was opened (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss)
checkFieldsGuidance.closedAt: Local ISO timestamp when the check was closed (null if still open)
checkFieldsGuidance.deliveryCompany: Third-party delivery company (e.g. 'Talabat', 'Elmenus', '' if direct delivery, null for non-delivery)
checkFieldsGuidance.netSales: Net sales before service charge and VAT
checkFieldsGuidance.entTax: Entertainment tax amount (only included if entTax > 0)
checkFieldsGuidance.discount: Total discount amount deducted on the check
checkFieldsGuidance.updatedAt: Timestamp when check or items were last modified (e.g. after voids); otherwise matches closedAt/openedAt

items.name: Item name in English (fallback to Arabic)
items.category: Item category name from POS group
items.voided: Boolean indicating whether this item line was voided (true/false)

notes: The 'dateFrom' and 'dateTo' parameters in the report endpoints are mandatory and must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
All report endpoints can be accessed via '/api/v1/report/*' or directly via '/report/*'.
All report endpoints require the 'x-api-key' HTTP header for authentication.
